extraction.Name: Julia Goodwin Little Horse
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment to her section of land, but that she was informed by the Indian Agency that she would have to accept it any way, and she did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold three quarters of her allotment, for cash, in 1920; that on the remaining quarter there are some taxes against, but that she never paid it; that there is no mortgage or other debts against this land
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: on the remaining quarter there are some taxes against, but that she never paid it
extraction.NOTES: mentally incompetent; health is not good, being pretty deaf and in generally run down condition; has a husband 73 years old, whose health is poor and he is unable to work; husband draws rations from the United States Government; has never received any help from the County or United States Government; document subscribed and sworn November 16, 1928
